# Overview

We here use data from healthy antrum Infinium EPIC arrays to classify CpG sites into three classes - biallelically methylated (mm), biallelically unmethylated (uu) and hemimethylated (um) sites. 

```{r, message=FALSE}
load("../../../../Data/Processed/ClonalCultures/DNAm/myNorm_IM_nonIM_and_healthy_stomach.RData")

load("../../../../Data/Processed/ClonalCultures/DNAm/myLoad_IM_nonIM_and_healthy_stomach.RData")

ed = myLoad$pd |> as.data.frame()
rm(myLoad)
ed$SampleLabel <- ifelse(ed$Project=="2020-186-ILL", paste0(ed$Sample_Group, "_", ed$PatientID, "_", ed$CloneID), ed$Sample_Name )

ed$Sample_Group2 <- ifelse(ed$Project == "2020-186-ILL", paste0("Clonal-",ed$Sample_Group), ifelse(ed$Project=="KFR_IM", paste0("Polyclonal-",ed$Sample_Group), paste0("Healthy-", ed$Stomach_site)) )

ed$Sample_Group2 <- factor(ed$Sample_Group2, levels=c("Healthy-Antrum","Healthy-Corpus","Healthy-Fundus","Polyclonal-Normal","Clonal-non-IM","Polyclonal-Atrophy","Polyclonal-IM","Clonal-IM"))
```

## Healthy antrum

```{r}
mm = myNorm[, subset(ed, Sample_Group2 %in% c("Healthy-Antrum", "Healthy-Corpus"))$Sample_ID]

row_means_by_site <- limma::avearrays(mm, ed[colnames(mm), "Stomach_site"])


cpg_class_u.m_array <- apply(row_means_by_site, 2, function(x) {ifelse(x < 0.25, "uu", ifelse(x>0.75, "mm", "um")) |> factor(levels=c("uu","um","mm")) }, simplify = F  ) |> as.data.frame()

for (n in colnames(row_means_by_site)) {
  v <- row_means_by_site[, n]
  hist(v, 100, main=paste0("Mean beta in healthy ",n, " samples") )
  abline(v=c(0.25, 0.75), lty=2, lwd=1, col="red")
  
  m <- table(cpg_class_u.m_array[, n], dnn=c(paste0("Methylation class ",n)))
  print(m)
  m |> prop.table()  |> round(digits=3) |> print()
}

table(cpg_class_u.m_array$Antrum, cpg_class_u.m_array$Corpus, dnn=c("Antrum", "Corpus")) |> prop.table() |> round(digits=3)

```

# WGS methylation classes

See Data/ExtData/Other_Methylation_data/GSE186458_WGBS_Atlas/Analysis/Antrum_methylation_class_WGS.Rmd for details. 
[0=uu, 1=um, 2=mm]

```{r}
cpg_class_wgs <- readRDS("../../../../Data/Processed/WGBS/WGS_Cpg_Meth_classes_EPIC.rds")
```


```{r}
table(cpg_class_wgs[, "Gastric.antrum"])
```

```{r}
# this is very slow and in fact I don't know if it ever returns without error
# tmp <- merge(cpg_class_u.m_array, as.data.frame(cpg_class_wgs), by.x=0, by.y=0, all.y=T, all.x=T)
t1 <- cpg_class_u.m_array
colnames(t1) <- paste0(colnames(t1), "_EPIC")
t1 <- apply(t1, 2, as.character) |> as.data.frame()
rownames(t1) <- rownames(cpg_class_u.m_array)
t1$ID <- rownames(t1)

num_to_label <- c("uu","um","mm")
t2 <- cpg_class_wgs |> as.data.frame()
colnames(t2) <- paste0(colnames(t2), "_WGS")
t2 <- apply(t2,2, function(x) num_to_label[x+1]) |> as.data.frame()
rownames(t2) <- rownames(cpg_class_wgs)
t2$ID <- rownames(t2)
tmp <- merge(t1, t2, by="ID", all.x=T, all.y=T)

m <- table(tmp$Antrum_EPIC, tmp$Gastric.antrum_WGS, dnn=c("EPIC","WGS"))
m
prop.table(m) |> round(digits = 3)
prop.table(m) |> pheatmap::pheatmap()

table(tmp$Antrum_EPIC == tmp$Gastric.antrum_WGS, dnn="Concordance Antrum CpG") |> prop.table()
```

# Export

We export the full table of CpGs with classification in EPIC methylation array (Antrum, Corpus) and WGS (Gastric fundus/corpus/antrum, SI, Colon left / right) to file *CpG_classifications_u.m_EPIC_and_WGS.rds*.

```{r}
saveRDS(tmp, file="../../../../Data/Processed/CpG_classifications_u.m_EPIC_and_WGS.rds", compress=T)
```
